name: NAME-KEPT-the-old-law
new: if (tier !== 'legendary') item.name = rarityName(item, tier, item.affixes.filter((a) => a?.gem == null));
note: the reforge names the piece again from its template, as before

name: NAME-KEPT-own-name-lost
old: return ladderBuilt(was, was?.rarity, was?.name) ? ladderName(item, tier) : was?.name;
note: a name of the piece's own named by the ladder anyway

name: NAME-KEPT-any-prefix
note: a name with anything before its base read as the ladder's

name: NAME-KEPT-any-suffix
note: a name with anything after its base read as the ladder's

name: NAME-KEPT-jewel-base-out
note: a crafted jewel built on its template - its metal and gem lost

name: NAME-KEPT-mark-takes-words
note: a Masterwork given the ladder's words its mark withholds

name: NAME-KEPT-band-of-magic
note: a Rare's words read as a Magic's

name: NAME-KEPT-bare-template-unread
note: an older reforge's name on the bare template read as the piece's own

name: NAME-KEPT-gem-words-name
note: a set gem's word names the piece (AUDIT GEM)

name: NAME-KEPT-repair-found-pieces
note: the load repairs a found piece's name - a cursed one's, by design without its curse's word

name: NAME-KEPT-imbue-renames
old: if (item.rarity === tier) item.name = linesName(item, tier, was);
note: the Imbue names a questline's reward from its template

name: NAME-KEPT-load-unrepaired
note: the load never repairs the old law's names

name: NAME-KEPT-masterwork-rri-base
why: parity with mintPiece, which names a Masterwork on its bare template: the Roleplay & Realism: Items word is '' with the mods off (test/modsOff.js), so no pin can tell the two; kept so a Masterwork's RRI armour is not renamed at its first reforge or load
